rationale: The V23 supplied-empty native prompt regenerated IDs. Use the existing canonical pointer context builder, which already closes Evidence and prefills Final answer, and the existing direct answer-line parser.
unchanged: All V23 observations, gates and primary-report hash stay unchanged. This is a new evaluation condition, not a replacement score.
replay_interface: Original selection prompt + Evidence: [IDs] newline + Final answer: newline. Generate only the answer continuation, parser_mode=direct, cap128. Empty/own/oracle use the identical answer-continuation interface.

note_sources.selected_id_replay: Valid generated IDs only, original order; no generated answer text. Invalid/missing/error note falls back to empty with explicit flag; retain every question.
note_sources.oracle: Original author support IDs only, privileged annotation; no answer text.

model: New protected terminal256 treatment only. Old models retain their existing native-control scores.
scoring: Existing designated first-answer-line parser, whole canonical answer EM, F1/aliases separate. Save raw tokens and repeated-header/bracket-line diagnostics. Prefilling is not a hard lexical ban on ID tokens.
comparisons: New native generated selection versus same-model native direct and original matched direct.
Canonical own-ID replay versus canonical empty-ID replay and oracle-ID replay.
interpretation: Fixed-pointer answer regeneration isolates content more cleanly than the refilling prompt; it is distinct from native thought generation, with any canonicalization disclosed. Held255 reuse is developmental.
budget: Same overall0.6 reserved chip-hour evaluation bound; optional likelihood diagnostics run only if the remaining bound permits. No prompt/parser rescue based on outputs.
qualification: No new numerical kernel or sampler: same frozen decoder, max128 and tested direct/anchored answer parsers. CPU projection/closure checks precede calls. Each actual worker still passes its own current-model and cached-prefill checks.
supersedes: Oracle is evaluated through the matched answer-replay interface instead of a separate native oracle-generation mode. Native modes are direct/selection. This prospective clarification changes no old observation or fitting rule.
